title: The Core
description: In order to save mankind, scientists and astronauts must set off a nuclear device at the center of the Earth.

title: Event Horizon
description: A spaceship missing for seven years finally re-emerges and sends out a distress signal. But when a team is sent out to investigate, they discover that something sinister has taken over the craft.

title: Flight
description: A veteran pilot (Denzel Washington) makes a miraculous landing after a mechanical malfunction sends his plane hurtling toward the ground, but an investigation into the incident reveals that he was drunk at the time.

title: Collateral
description: A contract killer hijacks a cab and forces the driver to transport him to his assigned jobs in Los Angeles.

title: 10 Cloverfield Lane
description: A woman (Mary Elizabeth Winstead) discovers the horrifying truth about the outside world while living in an underground shelter with two men (John Goodman, John Gallagher Jr.).

title: Gone Baby Gone
description: Two private investigators (Casey Affleck, Michelle Monaghan) tread dangerous ground as they scour the Boston underworld for a kidnapped child.

title: Doubt
description: Suspicions of child abuse fuel a traditionalist nun's (Meryl Streep) personal crusade against a popular priest (Philip Seymour Hoffman) who wants to reform her school's strict customs.

title: Dead Man Walking
description: A nun helps a double murderer deal with his actions and prepare for his execution in a New Orleans prison.

title: John Carpenter's Escape From L.A.
description: The fascist U.S. president enlists a jailed war hero (Kurt Russell) to retrieve a top-secret device stolen by his daughter on island Los Angeles in 2013.

title: The Manchurian Candidate
description: A troubled Gulf War veteran (Denzel Washington) becomes suspicious after a powerful senator's (Meryl Streep) son (Liev Schreiber) becomes a candidate for vice president.

title: Paycheck
description: After learning that his memory has been erased, a technical wizard (Ben Affleck) goes on the run to piece together clues from his past.

title: Rounders
description: The release of his debt-ridden pal (Edward Norton) from jail spurs a law student (Matt Damon) to resume high-stakes gambling.

title: Double Jeopardy
description: In an insurance scam, a man fakes his death and sets his wife up to take the blame. After serving 10 years in prison, she sets out to get revenge, immune from the law since she cannot be re-prosecuted for the same crime.

title: Escape From Alcatraz
description: A hardened con with a history of prison breaks, is sent to serve the rest of his life sentence at Alcatraz, America's most infamously brutal and inescapable maximum security prison.

description: Two stoners unwittingly smuggle a van that is built entirely from marijuana, from Mexico to L.A.

description: A pampered actor and his co-stars must become actual soldiers when the war movie they are filming in Southeast Asia turns into the real thing.

title: Black Sheep
description: To head off political embarrassment, the aide (David Spade) of a gubernatorial candidate (Tim Matheson) shepherds his boss's uncouth brother (Chris Farley).

title: Norbit
description: Though married to a terrible shrew, a man (Eddie Murphy) tries to figure out a way to be with his childhood sweetheart (Thandie Newton), who has just moved back into town.

description: In 2019 a mercenary (Djimon Hounsou) pursues two clones (Ewan McGregor, Scarlett Johansson) who escaped from a research facility after learning their true fate.

title: Eagle Eye
description: Two strangers (Shia LaBeouf, Michelle Monaghan) become pawns of a mysterious woman who threatens their friends and family and uses technology to control their actions.

title: Congo
description: Killer gorillas menace an ex-CIA agent (Laura Linney), a primatologist (Dylan Walsh) and others on a mission in Africa.
